The Broncos were led by seventh-year head coach [[Herb Sendek]] and played their home games at the [[Leavey Center]] as members of the [[West Coast Conference]] (WCC). ==Previous season== The [[2021–22 Santa Clara Broncos men's basketball team|Broncos]] finished the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2021–22 season]] 21–12, 10–5 in WCC play, to finish in third place. They defeated [[2021–22 Portland Pilots men's basketball team|Portland]] in the third round of the [[2022 West Coast Conference men's basketball tournament|WCC tournament]] before losing in the semifinals to [[2021–22 Saint Mary's Gaels men's basketball team|Saint Mary's]].
